events.verdict: Brunson (NYK) briefly grasps and immediately releases Pritchard's (BOS) arm during the rebound.
Porzingis (BOS) contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Pritchard (BOS) and White (BOS) both make clean contact with the ball prior to Anunoby's (NYK) shot attempt at the basket.
Towns (NYK) wraps his arm around Porzingis's (BOS) opposite-side hip, affecting his FOM.
Porzingis (BOS) extends his lower body slightly into Bridges (NYK), but the contact during the pick is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: White's (BOS) pass is thrown out of bounds and possession is awarded to the Knicks.
Towns (NYK) makes contact with Tatum's (BOS) arm, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Porzingis (BOS) moves laterally into Brunson's (NYK) path, but the contact when they come together is marginal.
Tatum (BOS) and Kornet (BOS) legally contest Hart's (NYK) layup attempt.
Anunoby (NYK) legally contests Tatum's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Holiday (BOS) legally contests Hart's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) initiates contact with Porzingis's (BOS) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Hart (NYK) momentarily rests his hand on White's (BOS) front as he firms up.
Tatum (BOS) firms up in a screening position in Bridges' (NYK) path and does not deliver contact.
White (BOS) and Hart (NYK) both firmly get their hands on the ball and a held ball is whistled before White lands out of bounds.

White (BOS) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released. Any marginal foot contact, following the release and incidental "high-five" contact, is created by Brunson extending his left leg toward White.
Hart (NYK) makes clean contact with the ball during his dislodge attempt as Porzingis (BOS) secures the rebound.
White (BOS) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.
Brunson (NYK) initiates illegal contact with Porzingis's (BOS) head/face after he releases the ball, which affects the follow-through on his jump shot attempt.
Porzingis (BOS) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Hauser's (BOS) foot is touching the sideline out of bounds before he jumps and makes contact with the ball.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Bridges (NYK) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Anunoby (NYK) briefly has his arms positioned around Tatum (BOS), but immediately removes them and allows Tatum to move freely.
Hart (NYK) commits a take foul on Holiday (BOS).
White (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position alongside of Anunoby's (NYK) path to the basket and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Brunson (NYK) commits a take foul on Holiday (BOS).
Pritchard (BOS) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
